A Different Kind of Year-End Reset  
At the end of the year, there can be so much pressure to evaluate what we accomplished and immediately start planning how we will improve ourselves next year.  
This retreat offers another way:  
Before setting new goals, we listen  
Before adding more, we release.  
Before asking what comes next, we honor where we are.  
You are allowed to end the year softly, surrender what was, rest in what is, create space for what wants to emerge.
